hero.headline: Make Chores Fun.
hero.subheadline: Taskaroo turns household tasks into a game your kids actually want to play. Points, levels, streaks, and real rewards.

features.title: Everything Your Family Needs
features.subtitle: Built by parents, for parents. Taskaroo combines psychology-backed gamification with practical task management.

pointsLevels.title: Points & Levels
pointsLevels.description: Earn points for every task, level up, and unlock achievements. Watch motivation soar as kids chase their next milestone.

streaks.title: Streaks & Combos
streaks.description: Build daily streaks for bonus motivation. Combo bonuses reward consistent helpers with up to 50% extra points.

childFriendly.title: Child-Friendly
childFriendly.description: Kids log in with a simple PIN - no email needed. Big buttons, colorful design, and clear instructions they can follow.

approval.title: Parent Approval
approval.description: Verify tasks are truly done before points are awarded. You stay in control while kids learn accountability.

rewards.title: Real Rewards
rewards.description: Convert points to allowance, screen time, or custom rewards. Make the connection between effort and outcome tangible.

leaderboard.title: Family Leaderboard
leaderboard.description: Healthy competition keeps everyone engaged. See who's leading this week and celebrate top performers together.

howItWorks.title: Up and Running in Minutes
howItWorks.subtitle: No complicated setup. No learning curve. Just results.

step1.title: Create Your Family
step1.description: Sign up and invite family members with a simple code. Parents and kids join in seconds.

step2.title: Add Tasks
step2.description: Create chores with point values and due dates. Set up recurring tasks once, they appear automatically.

step3.title: Kids Complete
step3.description: Children see a fun, game-like dashboard designed just for them. Swipe through tasks and tap to complete.

step4.title: Approve & Celebrate
step4.description: Verify completed tasks with one tap. Watch confetti fly and points add up!

testimonials.title: Families Love Taskaroo
testimonials.subtitle: Join thousands of families who've transformed chore time into fun time.

quote1.text: Finally something that actually works! My kids race to finish their chores now.

pricing.title: Simple, Fair Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Start free. Upgrade when you're ready.
